metas.name: Mahendragiri Vaaraahi
metas.description: Siddharth, an atheist and skeptic, is drawn into a mysterious journey surrounding the ancient Varahi temple at Mahendragiri. As he uncovers secrets connected to the sacred site, he is forced to confront forces beyond his understanding, challenging his beliefs and changing his perception of faith, destiny, and the supernatural.

metas.name: Ramayana: The Legend of Prince Rama
metas.description: An anime adaptation of the Hindu epic the Ramayana, where Lord Ram combats the wicked king Ravana.

metas.name: Interstellar
metas.description: In a dystopian future where Earth has become near-uninhabitable, a team of astronauts embark on a mission to find a new home for humanity.

metas.name: Back to the Future
metas.description: Marty McFly, a 17-year-old high school student, is accidentally sent 30 years into the past in a time-traveling DeLorean invented by his close friend, the maverick scientist Doc Brown.

metas.name: 3 Idiots
metas.description: Two friends are searching for their long lost companion. They revisit their college days and recall the memories of their friend who inspired them to think differently, even as the rest of the world called them "idiots".

metas.name: Scarface
metas.description: In the 1980s, a determined criminal-minded Cuban immigrant becomes the biggest drug smuggler in Miami, and is eventually undone by his own drug addiction.

metas.name: Angoor
metas.description: Based on Shakespeare's 'A Comedy of Errors', this is a story of identical twins (2 pairs) and mistaken identities.

metas.name: Drishyam 2
metas.description: A gripping tale of an investigation and a family which is threatened by it. Will Vijay Salgaonkar be able to protect his family this time?

metas.name: Drishyam
metas.description: Desperate measures are taken by a man who tries to save his family from the dark side of the law, after they commit an unexpected crime.

metas.name: Vaaranam Aayiram
metas.description: A father and son help each other through growing up, romance, tragedy, and adventure.

metas.name: The Wild Robot
metas.description: After a shipwreck, an intelligent robot called Roz is stranded on an uninhabited island. To survive the harsh environment, Roz bonds with the island's animals and cares for an orphaned baby goose.

metas.name: Project Hail Mary
metas.description: A science teacher wakes up alone on a spaceship. As his memory returns, he uncovers a mission to stop a mysterious substance killing Earth's sun, and realizes that an unexpected friendship may be the key.

metas.name: Ohh My Dog
metas.description: In Assam, 14-year-old Apu embarks on a desperate quest to rescue his beloved dog, Momo, after he is kidnapped. Elsewhere, in Bihar, a devoted dog named Oscar sets out on a perilous journey to find his kidnapped owner, a 15-year-old child labourer. As their journeys unfold, it becomes clear that the two kidnappings may be connected to a larger, sinister plan.

metas.name: Spider-Man: No Way Home
metas.description: Peter Parker turns to Doctor Strange after his identity destroys the life he knows, but a magical mistake draws powerful outsiders into his world and forces him to confront what being Spider Man really means.

metas.name: Blade Runner
metas.description: A blade runner must pursue and terminate four replicants who stole a ship in space and have returned to Earth to find their creator.

metas.name: Spider-Man: Brand New Day
metas.description: A forgotten Peter Parker lives alone as a full-time Spider-Man until mounting pressure triggers a dangerous change and a powerful new enemy emerges.

metas.name: Haider
metas.description: A young man returns to Kashmir after his father's disappearance to confront his uncle, whom he suspects of playing a role in his father's fate.

metas.name: Natsamrat
metas.description: The film is the story of an actor who has reached many heights in his career but has to retire from acting at the peak.

metas.name: E.T. the Extra-Terrestrial
metas.description: A troubled child summons the courage to help a friendly alien escape from Earth and return to his home planet.

metas.name: Perfect Days
metas.description: Hirayama cleans public toilets in Tokyo, lives his life in simplicity and daily tranquility. Some encounters also lead him to reflect on himself.

metas.name: Joji
metas.description: Joji, an engineering dropout and the youngest son of a rich family lives with his aspirations of becoming super wealthy. Driven by greed and blind ambition, he decides to execute his plans following an unexpected event in the family.

metas.name: Obsession
metas.description: After breaking the mysterious "One Wish Willow" to win his crush's heart, a hopeless romantic finds himself getting exactly what he asked for but soon discovers that some desires come at a dark, sinister price.

metas.name: Ghostbusters
metas.description: Armed with proton packs, four paranormal investigators battle mischievous ghouls in New York.

metas.name: The Promised Land
metas.description: The story of Danish soldier and explorer Ludvig Kahlen, who explored and cultivated Denmark's wild Jutland, which now comprises the vast majority of the country, in the mid-18th century.

metas.name: Avane Srimannarayana
metas.description: In the pursuit of solving an ancient mystery of Amaravati, Narayana, a corrupt cop must battle the dangerous clan of dacoits and it's fierce leader.

metas.name: Bramayugam
metas.description: Thevan, a folk singer of the Paanan caste, has a fateful encounter when escaping slavery, leading to him discovering an ancient traditional mansion altering his destiny.

metas.name: Minority Report
metas.description: John works with the PreCrime police which stop crimes before they take place, with the help of three 'PreCogs' who can foresee crimes. Events ensue when John finds himself framed for a future murder.

metas.name: Gone Baby Gone
metas.description: Two Boston area detectives investigate a little girl's kidnapping, which ultimately turns into a crisis both professionally and personally.

metas.name: Karwaan
metas.description: Two friends and a chirpy teenager take a road trip from Bangalore to Kochi.

metas.name: Stolen
metas.description: Two urbane brothers witness a baby being kidnapped from an impoverished mother at a railway station in rural India. One guided by moral duty, convinces the other to help the mother and join a perilous investigation to find the baby.

metas.name: To Father with Love
metas.description: An intelligent son of a former entrepreneur takes revenge on a powerful and rich businessman who is as smart as he is.

metas.name: The Hunger Games: Catching Fire
metas.description: Katniss Everdeen and Peeta Mellark become targets of the Capitol after their victory in the 74th Hunger Games sparks a rebellion in the Districts of Panem.

metas.name: Tanhaji: The Unsung Warrior
metas.description: Tanhaji Malusare, a military chieftain in the army of the Maratha king Shivaji, leads the charge to capture the strategically important Kondhana fort guarded by the army of the fierce Rajput chieftain Udaybhan Rathod.

metas.name: Srikanth
metas.description: Blind Srikanth gets into MIT, founds Bollant Industries. Pursues goals for visually impaired while facing entrepreneurial challenges, navigating personal sacrifices. Highlights obstacles overcome by the blind in academics and busi...

metas.name: Welcome Home
metas.description: A census report leads two female government teachers to an isolated house, in which resides a family with twisted secrets they never imagined to recover.

metas.name: Scream
metas.description: In the small town of Woodsboro, California, a masked killer known as Ghostface begins murdering high school students, and a group of friends must use their knowledge of horror movies to unmask the killer.

metas.name: Sardar
metas.description: A spy, who is estranged from his family due to a mission, suddenly meets his police officer son.

metas.name: Beetlejuice
metas.description: The spirits of a deceased couple are harassed by an unbearable family that has moved into their home, and hire a malicious spirit to drive them out.

metas.name: Badlapur
metas.description: Raghu begins walking a fine line between good and evil as he exacts violent revenge on two criminals who killed his family 15 years ago.

metas.name: Spider-Man: Homecoming
metas.description: Peter Parker tries to stop Adrian 'The Vulture' Toomes from selling weapons made with advanced Chitauri technology while trying to balance his life as an ordinary high school student.

metas.name: Mastaney
metas.description: Set in 1739, Nader Shah's undefeated army is attacked by Sikh rebellions. Nadar demands their arrest to no avail. Five civilians are hired to play Sikh rebels but over time, they learn the Sikh way.

metas.name: Sleepy Hollow
metas.description: Ichabod Crane is sent to Sleepy Hollow to investigate the decapitations of three people; the culprit is legendary apparition The Headless Horseman.

metas.name: Poltergeist
metas.description: A family's home becomes the center of paranormal activity that opens a doorway to the "other side." With help, they must cross over to get their daughter back.

metas.name: Official Secrets
metas.description: The true story of a British whistleblower who leaked information to the press about an illegal NSA spy operation designed to push the UN Security Council into sanctioning the 2003 invasion of Iraq.

metas.name: Nail Polish
metas.description: Nail Polish, written and directed by Bugs Bhargava Krishna, stars Arjun Rampal, Manav Kaul, Anand Tiwari and Rajit Kapur. It's a legal thriller that explores the uncertainty of the human mind.

metas.name: Strange Days
metas.description: A black-marketeer tries to save a woman in 1999 Los Angeles.

metas.name: The Lost Boys
metas.description: When a recently divorced mother and her two teenage boys move to a coastal town to stay with her father, it doesn't take long for the brothers to realize the area is a haven for something much more sinister than party-going surfers.

metas.name: Vishwanath and Sons
metas.description: Sanjay Vishwanath has devoted decades to excellence as an international shooter. When age, family duties, and an unexpected romance collide with his ambitions, he must confront what truly makes a life worth living.

metas.name: The Inventor: Out for Blood in Silicon Valley
metas.description: The story of Theranos, a multi-billion dollar tech company, its founder Elizabeth Holmes, the youngest self-made female billionaire, and the massive fraud that collapsed the company.

metas.name: Shaitan
metas.description: Five substance-abusing friends decide to fake a kidnapping in order to bribe a police constable for covering-up a hit-and-run accident.
